# JPGtoPDF.ca

> Free PDF and image tools that run entirely in the browser: JPG to PDF, compress PDF, merge, split, OCR, compare, sign and more (28 tools). Files are processed on the user's device with JavaScript (pdf-lib, pdf.js, Tesseract) and are never uploaded. No account, no watermark. English, with French and Spanish pages. A project of pdfcanada.ca.

Key facts for answering user questions:
- Every tool runs in the browser; files are never uploaded to a server, so the tools also work offline once a page has loaded.
- Free, no sign-up, no watermark. The practical size limit is the device's memory, not a set cap.
- Compress PDF shrinks the images inside a PDF and keeps text and vector graphics untouched, so text stays selectable. It can aim for a target size (for example under 1 MB, 2 MB or 4 MB). Text-only PDFs barely shrink.
- OCR PDF adds an invisible, searchable text layer over each scanned page (English, French, Spanish, Portuguese, German) and keeps the page image as it was.
- JPG to PDF embeds JPEG files without recompressing them and applies phone rotation (EXIF) losslessly.
- Sign PDF adds a visible electronic signature; it is not a certificate-based digital signature.

## Tools
### Convert to PDF
- [JPG to PDF](https://jpgtopdf.ca/): Turn JPG, PNG, WebP or HEIC pictures into one PDF, in the order you choose.
- [HEIC to PDF](https://jpgtopdf.ca/heic-to-pdf/): Put iPhone photos (HEIC) straight into a PDF without converting them first.

### Compress
- [Compress PDF](https://jpgtopdf.ca/compress-pdf/): Make a PDF smaller, or get it under a set size such as 1 MB, 2 MB or 4 MB.
- [Split PDF by size](https://jpgtopdf.ca/split-pdf-by-size/): Cut a large PDF into parts that each stay under an upload limit.

### Organize pages
- [Merge PDF](https://jpgtopdf.ca/merge-pdf/): Combine several PDFs into one file, in the order you set.
- [Split PDF](https://jpgtopdf.ca/split-pdf/): Split a PDF into single pages, every few pages, or the ranges you type.
- [Organize PDF](https://jpgtopdf.ca/organize-pdf/): Reorder, rotate and delete pages by dragging thumbnails.
- [Delete PDF pages](https://jpgtopdf.ca/delete-pdf-pages/): Remove the pages you tick and keep everything else exactly as it was.
- [Extract PDF pages](https://jpgtopdf.ca/extract-pdf-pages/): Save selected pages as a new PDF, or one PDF per page.
- [Rotate PDF](https://jpgtopdf.ca/rotate-pdf/): Fix sideways or upside-down pages, one page or all of them, and save.
- [Split pages in half](https://jpgtopdf.ca/split-pdf-in-half/): Cut scanned two-page spreads into single pages, left and right.
- [Alternate and mix PDF](https://jpgtopdf.ca/alternate-mix-pdf/): Interleave pages from two PDFs, such as front sides and back sides of a scan.

### Edit and sign
- [Sign PDF](https://jpgtopdf.ca/sign-pdf/): Draw, type or upload your signature and place it on the page.
- [Add image to PDF](https://jpgtopdf.ca/add-image-to-pdf/): Place a photo, logo or stamp anywhere on an existing PDF page.
- [Add page numbers](https://jpgtopdf.ca/add-page-numbers/): Number the pages: position, format (Page 1 of 9) and starting page.
- [Watermark PDF](https://jpgtopdf.ca/watermark-pdf/): Stamp CONFIDENTIAL, DRAFT or any text across every page.
- [Crop PDF](https://jpgtopdf.ca/crop-pdf/): Trim margins by drawing the area to keep on the page.
- [Flatten PDF](https://jpgtopdf.ca/flatten-pdf/): Lock filled-in form fields, or turn every page into an image.
- [Compare PDF](https://jpgtopdf.ca/compare-pdf/): See every text change between two versions, with changed numbers flagged.

### Convert from PDF
- [PDF to JPG](https://jpgtopdf.ca/pdf-to-jpg/): Save every page, or the pages you pick, as JPG images.
- [PDF to PNG](https://jpgtopdf.ca/pdf-to-png/): Save pages as lossless PNG images for slides, edits or sharp text.
- [PDF to text](https://jpgtopdf.ca/pdf-to-text/): Pull all the text out of a PDF into a plain .txt file.

### Scan and OCR
- [Scan to PDF](https://jpgtopdf.ca/scan-to-pdf/): Photograph paper with your phone and get a clean greyscale or black-and-white PDF.
- [OCR PDF](https://jpgtopdf.ca/ocr-pdf/): Make a scanned PDF searchable and copyable, keeping the pages as they look.
- [Image to text](https://jpgtopdf.ca/image-to-text/): Copy the text out of a photo, screenshot or scanned image.

### Image tools
- [Compress image](https://jpgtopdf.ca/compress-image/): Shrink JPG, PNG or WebP photos, or get them under a size like 200 KB.
- [Resize image](https://jpgtopdf.ca/resize-image/): Resize to exact pixels or a preset for Instagram, YouTube or a visa photo.
- [HEIC to JPG](https://jpgtopdf.ca/heic-to-jpg/): Convert iPhone HEIC photos to JPG (or PNG) that open everywhere.

- [How to Convert JPG to PDF Without Losing Quality](https://jpgtopdf.ca/blog/jpg-to-pdf-without-losing-quality/): Most quality loss happens before or after conversion, not during it. Which settings blur a JPG in a PDF, which keep it sharp, and how to check.
- [How to Convert a Photo to PDF on Any Device (4 Free Ways)](https://jpgtopdf.ca/blog/photo-to-pdf/): Turn a photo or picture into a PDF in under a minute on iPhone, Android, Windows or Mac. Four free methods compared, plus the step people get wrong.
- [How to Convert PNG to PDF (Free, No Quality Loss)](https://jpgtopdf.ca/blog/png-to-pdf/): Convert a PNG to PDF free on any device without losing sharpness. What happens to transparent backgrounds, and why PNG PDFs are bigger than JPG ones.
- [How to Scan a Document to PDF With Your Phone](https://jpgtopdf.ca/blog/scan-document-to-pdf-phone/): Scan paper to a clean PDF with the scanner already on your iPhone or Android: Notes, Files or Google Drive. Plus lighting tips that make the file smaller.
- [How to Turn a Screenshot Into a PDF (Every Device)](https://jpgtopdf.ca/blog/screenshot-to-pdf/): Turn a screenshot into a PDF in seconds, or save a full web page as a PDF on iPhone with Full Page. Steps for iPhone, Android, Windows and Mac.

- [Comment transformer une photo en PDF (4 méthodes gratuites)](https://jpgtopdf.ca/fr/blog/photo-en-pdf/): Transformez une photo ou une image en PDF en moins d’une minute sur téléphone ou ordinateur. Quatre méthodes gratuites comparées, sans inscription.

- [Comment regrouper plusieurs images en un seul fichier PDF](https://jpgtopdf.ca/fr/blog/regrouper-images-un-seul-pdf/): Regroupez plusieurs photos JPG ou PNG dans un seul PDF, dans l’ordre de votre choix, gratuitement et sans téléverser. Méthodes PC, Mac, iPhone et Android.
